title: Quantum error mitigation by hierarchy-informed sampling: chiral dynamics in the Schwinger model
summary: Quantum simulations on current NISQ hardware are limited by its noisy nature, making efficient quantum error mitigation methods highly demanded. In this paper we introduce a novel mitigation scheme, applicable to arbitrary quantum simulations of time-dependent Hamiltonian dynamics on NISQ devices. The scheme uses a polynomial subset of extended qubit Bogoliubov-Born-Green-Kirkwood-Yvon (BBGKY) hierarchy equations as a sampling criterion of possible mitigated candidates for the quantum observables.
